text: Business Travel and Per-Diem Policy › 3. Provisions ¶ 3.1 The maximum entitlement is 33% of basic salary. 3.2 Requests shall be submitted no later than 32 working days before the intended start date. 3.3 Approval requires the line manager and then Human Resources. Approval authority may not be sub-delegated below grade 11. 3.4 This entitlement may not be combined with any equivalent entitlement for the same period.
